decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical disk buffer header and flag definitions.
evidence: The file matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
dossym.inc and smdossym.inc include buffer.inc; dos/buf.asm uses the structure fields and flags.
Prior DOS BUF module comparison covered 643 bytes; after alignment the only three differing bytes were marked external call displacements (review 044).
Prior FAT module comparison matched all 984 linked bytes at the target offsets (review 065).
limitations: These selected-build comparisons do not establish all possible structure uses or original historical source identity. Final linked addresses and complete MSDOS.SYS equality remain unverified.
